notes: Initial contract from defaults audit. Covers the 9 types in spec §2.5 plus Shape, Ellipse, LinearGradient, KeyedObject, KeyedProperty, StateMachine. All required_defaults reflect Go zero-value != Rive runtime default traps discovered in T-575.

entries.notes: blendModeValue=3 is pass-through. Go zero=0 would differ. fractionalWidth/Height needed for layout.
Transform node. No blendModeValue needed (Node is not a Drawable).
Shape is the container node for paths and paints. blendModeValue=3 (pass-through).
Rectangle is a ParametricPath child of Shape. originX/Y=0.5 centers the pivot.
Base class for Rectangle and Ellipse. Tested via Rectangle.
Ellipse is also a ParametricPath. Width/height are radiusX/radiusY * 2.
ShapePaint defaults: isVisible=true, blendModeValue=127 (normal blend). Go zero for isVisible=false causes invisible fills.
Stroke inherits ShapePaint defaults. thickness=0 (Go zero) would render invisible.
colorValue=0 is valid (transparent black). SolidColor is emitted BEFORE its parent Fill as a forward-reference pattern.
GradientStops are children of LinearGradient. No Go-zero traps at the gradient level.
fps=0 and speed=0 (Go zero) would cause animation playback issues. Builder defaults to fps=60, speed=1.0.
KeyedObject.objectId references the animated target by artboard-relative index. Tested via LinearAnimation fixture.
KeyedProperty.propertyKey is the animated property key. Tested via LinearAnimation fixture.
Image.assetId (key 206) must appear in ToC — WASM 2.37.6 C++ reader cannot resolve it from CoreRegistry. blendModeValue=3 (pass-through); Go zero=0 causes null load in WASM.
Tested with load-only (no render assertion). An empty state machine with no layers is valid.
